verdict.rationale: Otter documents its Public API only as a single prose help-center article with static examples. The same source states there is no interactive reference, no sandbox and no machine-readable spec (openapi.json returns 404), so explorable, runnable API docs are absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
